title: Fishing Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for fishing metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for fishing metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you the smoothed week-long trend in your value from fishing metric0.
